hint.text: The Tudors were the family that ruled England between the years 1485 and 1603.
hint.label: The Tudors

atoms.b: Queen Elizabeth I was born in 1533 during the ((++Tudor Victorian)) times.
atoms.sound: Queen Elizabuth the first was born in 1533 during the Tudor times.

atoms.b: Elizabeth’s father, King Henry VIII, is also one of the most famous rulers in history. He is known for having ((++six thirty)) wives!
atoms.sound: Elizabuths father, King Henry VIII, is also one of the most famous rulers in history. He is known for having six wives!

instruction.text: When Elizabeth was born, Henry was not very happy. Select the crown to find out why.

atoms.sound: In Tudor times, we didn’t think that girls should rule. I wanted a son to take my crown and become King after me!

end.text: This is Anne Boleyn. She was Queen Elizabeth I’s mother. When Elizabeth was only two years old, King Henry had Anne’s head chopped off!
end.sound: This is Anne-Boleyn. She was Queen Elizabuth the first’s mother. When Elizabuth was only two years old, King Henry had Annes head chopped off!

atoms.a: Elizabeth was very young when this happened. What do you think her childhood was like?
atoms.sound: Elizabuth was very young when this happened. What do you think her childhood was like?

instruction.text: You’re talking with a historian about Anne Boleyn. Fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: Why do you think that Anne Boleyn’s ((++head arm)) was chopped off?
The official reason was that she was plotting to ((++kill heal)) the King, but I think this was probably made up.
We know it was very important for Henry to have a ((++male female)) heir, but Anne Boleyn never gave Henry a son.

hint.text: An heir is the next person who will become king or queen after the ruling king or queen dies.
hint.label: Heir

atoms.b: It is likely this is why she was killed but, as this happened a ((++long short)) time ago, we can’t be sure.

hint.text: An heir is the next person who will become king or queen after the ruling king or queen dies.
hint.label: Heir

atoms.b: It sounds like it was very ((++difficult funny)) to be Henry VIII’s wife.
atoms.sound: It sounds like it was very difficult to be Henry the eighth’s wife

hint.text: An heir is the next person who will become king or queen after the ruling king or queen dies.
hint.label: Heir

feedback.finish: Did you know that Henry married his third wife, Jane Seymour, only 11 days after Anne died! She gave birth to Henry’s first son, Edward.

end.text: After Anne Boleyn died, Henry declared that their marriage was not real and pretended that it never happened. As a result, Elizabeth was no longer in line for the throne.
end.sound: After Anne Boleyn died, Henry declared that their marriage was not real and pretended that it never happened. As a result, Elizabuth was no longer in line for the throne.

atoms.a: How do you think Elizabeth might have felt about no longer being in line for the throne?
atoms.sound: How do you think Elizabuth might have felt about no longer being in line for the throne?
